doet.h2b: A good site does four things, even without you.
doet.lede: Pick one. You'll see it straight away on clinic3d.be, a site we built.

items.tekst: Anyone nearby looking for what you do should find you. We build your site fast and in a way Google reads well, and we fill in your Google profile completely and keep it up to date. Nobody can honestly promise you the top spot. What we can build is a site Google understands.

A real photo, your opening hours, your address and what customers say about you. That way, customers see straight away who they're coming to. And 2 hours after every appointment, your system asks for a review by itself.
One tap on the button and your customer has booked. The appointment planner and forms are built in, and customers can pay online with Bancontact, iDEAL, Visa or Apple Pay.
Every booking and every request lands in your CRM. Messages from WhatsApp, Instagram, email and phone sit together in one inbox.

items.q: How much does it cost to get a website made?
items.a: With us there's no separate price tag and no setup fee. Your website is part of Online Growth: €150 a month, excl. VAT and cancellable monthly. That also covers your Google profile, review requests, your CRM and online payments.

items.q: How much does a website cost per year?
items.a: Twelve times €150, so €1,800 a year, excl. VAT. That already includes the design, the build, hosting and management. You pay monthly and can stop any month.

items.q: How soon will my site be online?
Can customers book and pay online?
items.a: Yes. The appointment planner and forms are built in. Payments go through Stripe, with Bancontact, iDEAL, Visa or Apple Pay.

items.q: Does it come with a chatbot?
items.a: Not by default. The AI chatbot is an add-on at €50 a month. Want someone to answer your phone too? That's the AI receptionist: €150 a month plus €750 one-off. All prices excl. VAT.

items.q: I already have a site. Does it have to go?
items.a: No. If online booking is what you're after, we put the booking system on your existing site with an embed code. You can also use your own booking link. If you do want a new site, we build it around your business.

items.q: Will I be at the top of Google?
items.a: Nobody can honestly promise that. We build your site fast and in a way Google reads well, and we fill in your Google profile completely and keep it up to date.
We do. We build and manage your entire digital operation, and your website is part of that.
Online Growth is cancellable monthly. If you stop, we hand everything over to you: your website and all your data go to you.
